summary: Plan for implementing the 11 user enhancements: main page login/sign-up gate, removing bank details, making all 6 ADEK documents mandatory, country dropdown for nationality, gating payment portal behind Super-Admin approval, enhanced document preview & feedback for Admissions Staff, removing evaluator name and feedback from parent view, changing Student ID prefix to IES, stripping finance data from Registration views, and removing 'Recommended' from payment plans.
